plan.summary: BRO-5520: checked results from the owner’s Gemini and ChatGPT deep research runs (2026-27 season and long-running hits; 2025-26 season; nonprofit shows). Each figure below was opened at its source. New: Joe Turner’s Come and Gone $8M (producers’ investor Q&A), Here There Are Blueberries $7M max (SEC Form D), Paddington $31M, Purple Rain $29.5M and Galileo $23M (Broadway Journal, new records), Dolly $30M now cited to Broadway Journal, CATS: The Jellicle Ball’s running cost ~$1M (Playbill, replacing an $850K Reddit estimate), Little Bear Ridge Road’s $4.1M now cited to its SEC Form D ($4,095,000). Cleared: Dog Day Afternoon $9.5M and Damn Yankees $19M (no source; message-board guesses). Flagged as enhancements: A Few Good Men and School Girls (named commercial co-producers). Not applied (could not open the source from here): The Washington Post’s Oedipus $6.5M, The Lion King ~$20M (NYT 2003), Aladdin $12-15M projected (LA Times 2014), Variety’s Cats "failed to recoup", NYT’s Beaches investor losses, IBDB’s Jun 23 2026 Rocky Horror producer change. Rejected: Celebrity Autobiography "recouped $2.3M", All Out $31.5M, Beaches $12.5M recoupment, Rocky Horror "fully recouped". (part 1 of 2: joe-turners-come-and-gone, dog-day-afternoon, little-bear-ridge-road, here-there-are-blueberries, damn-yankees, dolly-an-original-musical)
